parent_objective: audit no-rerun combined outcome and seed-diversity result before next route
blocked_by: M2187 audit result must be interpreted before repair or comparison design
supersedes: direct ranking after no-rerun combined audit

public_gates: M2188 must audit M2187 summary and flags
M2188 must decide whether comparison remains blocked
M2188 must route support failure and seed-diversity suspicion explicitly
M2188 must not rank profiles or select a winner
M2188 must not claim finite-window vs GRU
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits comparison-readiness failure and chooses repair route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2187 summary is missing
stop if support failure or seed-diversity suspicion is not classified
stop if audit would rank profiles
stop if next route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to task-quality/offtrack repair if support is the primary blocker
route to repeat seed-diversity repair if seed independence is invalid
route to synthesis if both blockers require branch pivot

training_stage.stage_objective: audit no-rerun combined repeat data-quality result
allowed_updates: M2188 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest chosen by audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2188 audits aggregate data quality and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2188.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record comparison-readiness failure and route repair; do not weaken ranking threshold.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits new repeat data-quality result before deciding repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can choose support repair or seed-diversity repair but cannot rank profiles
must_synthesize_if: M2188 cannot decide the next route
M2188 identifies both support and seed-diversity as major blockers needing branch pivot

hypothesis: The M2187 no-rerun audit result should block comparison and route to explicit support/seed-diversity repair.
success_criteria: no ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: audit claims paper-level evidence or finite-window vs GRU
decision_rule: M2188 passes if it audits M2187 and chooses a repair route without ranking profiles.
